body.title: Senior Dairy Expert – Process Optimization - Continuous Improvement
body.aiReason: Job needs dairy process expertise; freelancer's core skills are data/ML but no dairy domain experience, so not a fit.
body.description:
Hello,
We are a German Industrial AI company with our own software for Dairy Process Optimization.
We are looking for a Senior Dairy Expert with hands-on experience in dairy process optimization who can support our customers in:
Identifying data gaps and improvement opportunities within the software
Deriving meaningful process insights and analyses from plant data
Working with plant teams to design and execute relevant DoE (Design of Experiments)
Supporting improvements in product quality, yield, and process consistency
We are looking for someone with strong practical dairy-process knowledge who can bridge the gap between plant expertise and Industrial AI/data analytics.
If this sounds relevant to your experience, we would be happy to connect and discuss the opportunity further.
